links.outcome: Triage recommendation accuracy on 45 standardized vignettes
links.effect: Triage accuracy was 57.8% (95% CI, 42.9% to 72.7%); first-pass diagnostic accuracy was 75.6% (95% CI, 62.6% to 88.5%).
links.quote: When presented with 45 vignettes, ChatGPT identified illnesses with 75.6% (95% CI, 62.6% to 88.5%) first-pass diagnostic accuracy and 57.8% (95% CI, 42.9% to 72.7%) triage accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to generate and rewrite clinical vignettes with human review for symptom dropping or addition

screen.reason: The study tests the capabilities of ChatGPT to generate, rewrite (at different health literacy levels), and diagnose/triage clinical vignettes. It evaluates model performance across different prompt tasks rather than testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice.
